name: Race
definition: A single Grand Prix event held on a specific date at a specific circuit within a championship season, identified by raceId and ordered within the season by round.
scope: Race-level analysis of the Formula 1 World Championship, seasons 1950-2017.

name: Driver
definition: A person who competed in a championship race, identified by driverId with a stable driverRef plus forename, surname, date of birth and nationality.
scope: Driver-level career, performance and championship analysis.

name: Constructor
definition: An entrant organisation (team or chassis constructor) that fielded cars in championship races, identified by constructorId with a name and nationality.
scope: Constructor-level performance, entry and championship analysis.

name: Circuit
definition: A racing venue at a geographic location, identified by circuitId with circuitRef, name, location, country and coordinates.
scope: Venue and geographic analysis of championship races.

name: Season
definition: A championship year, identified by the seasons.year primary key; each season is a series of races numbered by round.
scope: Season-level and cross-era analysis.

name: Race Result Entry
definition: One entry record in a race classification: the outcome of a single car, driver and constructor combination in a single race, carrying grid slot, finishing position, laps completed, points and status.
scope: The atomic unit of race outcome analysis.

name: Finishing Position
definition: The official finishing position of an entry in a race classification, recorded as a number, and NULL for entries that were not classified.
scope: Finish-order analysis; distinct from championship standings position and from grid position.

name: Race Points
definition: Championship points awarded to a driver entry for a single race, determined by the scoring system in force in that season.
scope: Per-race points for a driver entry; comparable within a scoring era, not across eras without normalisation.

name: Constructor Race Points
definition: Championship points credited to a constructor for a single race, recorded separately from driver points.
scope: Per-race constructor points; subject to era-specific counting rules for multi-car entries.

name: Championship Points
definition: Season-to-date cumulative championship points for a driver or constructor as of a given race, recorded in the standings tables.
scope: Championship progression analysis within one season.

name: Championship Position
definition: The championship ranking of a driver or constructor as of a given race in a season, where 1 is the leader.
scope: Championship ranking analysis; distinct from race finishing position.

name: Race Win
definition: A race outcome in which an entry is classified first, that is its finishing position equals 1.
scope: Win counting for drivers and constructors.

name: Podium Finish
definition: A race outcome in which an entry is classified in one of the first three finishing places.
scope: Podium counting for drivers and constructors.

name: Grid Position
definition: The starting grid slot of an entry for a race; a value of 0 means the entry was given no grid slot, for example a pit-lane start or a failure to qualify.
scope: Starting-position analysis; not identical to qualifying classification because of penalties and pit-lane starts.

name: Qualifying Position
definition: The classification position achieved in the qualifying session of a race weekend.
scope: Qualifying performance analysis, available for 1994-2017.

name: Lap Time
definition: The elapsed time of one completed lap by one driver in one race, recorded in milliseconds with a textual equivalent.
scope: Lap-level pace analysis, available for 1996-2017 races only.

name: Pit Stop Duration
definition: The elapsed time of a single pit stop by one driver in one race, recorded in milliseconds with a textual equivalent.
scope: Pit-lane performance analysis, available for 2011-2017 races only.

name: Race Time
definition: The elapsed race time of an entry; for the winner it is the absolute race duration and for other entries a cumulative value from which the gap to the winner can be derived.
scope: Race duration and gap analysis; recorded only for entries that completed the winner's lap count.

name: Fastest Lap
definition: The quickest single lap recorded by an entry in a race; an entry holds the race fastest lap when its fastest-lap rank equals 1.
scope: Fastest-lap analysis; rank and speed fields are populated only from 2004 onward.

name: Laps Completed
definition: The number of race laps an entry completed before finishing or retiring.
scope: Distance and classification analysis; entries that did not start record 0 laps.

name: Car Status
definition: The categorised outcome or failure reason recorded for an entry in a race, held in the status reference table and referenced by results.statusId.
scope: Reliability and outcome-category analysis across all seasons.

name: Classification Status
definition: The single-character code in positionText that states how an entry was classified: a numeric finishing place for classified cars, or R, D, E, W, F, N for retired, disqualified, excluded, withdrawn, failed-to-qualify or not-classified entries.
scope: Classification and non-finish analysis.

name: Retirement
definition: A race entry that did not finish and was not classified, recorded with a non-numeric classification code and a NULL finishing position, together with a car status giving the reason.
scope: Reliability analysis; excludes disqualified and excluded entries, which are separate outcomes.

name: Classified Finisher
definition: A race entry that received an official numeric finishing position, whether or not it completed the winner's full lap count.
scope: Classification analysis; a classified entry may still be several laps down.

name: Nationality
definition: The nationality attribute of a driver or constructor, stored as an adjectival country form such as British or Italian.
scope: Driver and constructor demographic analysis; not comparable with the nominal country vocabulary used for circuits.

name: Circuit Country
definition: The country in which a circuit is located, stored as a nominal country form such as UK or USA.
scope: Geographic analysis of race venues.

name: Car Number
definition: The car number carried by an entry in a race, recorded per race in results and qualifying.
scope: Car-number identification; distinct from the permanent driver number that appears in drivers.number only from 2014.

name: Shared Drive
definition: A race situation in which more than one driver entry corresponds to the same car and race, so that one race can hold several result rows for one driver or more than two drivers for one constructor.
scope: Grain and participation analysis; observed in 1950-1978.
